title: On Elephant Random Walk with Delayed Amnesia
summary: In this paper, we introduce a modified elephant random walk that exhibits a transition from a uniform memory mechanism to a selective amnesic memory mechanism. Using a vector martingale approach, we study the asymptotic behaviour of the walk across different parameter regimes. In the diffusive and critical regimes, we establish almost sure convergence results, laws of iterated logarithm, asymptotic normality of the walk, and the growth rate of mean square displacement.
